title: Renewables Lab: individual energy mechanisms
assumptions: Direct-beam model only: no diffuse sky light, shading, temperature effects, tracking schedule, or inverter clipping. A 90° beam contributes zero. This is not a daily yield estimate.
scenarioAssumptions: Synthetic resource sequences and battery requests are prescribed teaching inputs. Power is held over each one-minute interval; the final endpoint adds no energy. Battery requests remain fixed when capacity or power is changed.
formula: P_AC = irradiance × area × cos(angle) × module efficiency × 0.96 / 1,000

context: Operating scenario changed: Steady conditions → Passing clouds
